content.text: I changed one file, `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (1 passed). The bug was an off-by-one in `TTLCache._expired`: it used `clock() - ts > ttl`, so an entry was still treated as live at exactly `ttl` seconds after insertion, and only expired after that. I changed it to `>=` so an entry expires the moment its age reaches `ttl`. Every expiry check in the cache goes through `_expired`: lookups in `get`, the live-entry count in `put` that decides whether to evict, and `_purge`. So all of them now use the same boundary, rather than only the case the visible test covers. One thing I noticed but left alone, since the issue doesn't mention it: `put` only clears out expired entries when the cache is full of live ones, and `__len__` counts expired entries that haven't been removed yet. That means `len(cache)` can go above `capacity`.
